record.name: Weapon Modifications
record.narrative: You can modify your weapons with specialized attachments. Choose one weapon you're proficient with. It gains one of the following properties: extended range, increased damage, or the ability to deal different damage types. This ability represents a mastery of the Force and years of dedicated training. When used, it demonstrates the character's expertise and connection to their chosen path.
record.flavor_text: 'Weapon Modifications represents the pinnacle of mastery.' - Unknown Master

mechanics.description: As a free, you can use this ability.

llm_guidance.roleplay_guidance: When using Weapon Modifications, describe the character's expertise and the visible effects of their power. Focus on the narrative impact and how it affects the scene.
llm_guidance.tactical_notes: Weapon Modifications should be used strategically to maximize its effectiveness. Consider the timing and positioning for optimal results.
narrative_hooks: The use of Weapon Modifications creates an opportunity for character development
An enemy attempts to counter or resist Weapon Modifications
The effects of Weapon Modifications have unexpected consequences

image_generation.base_prompt: A character using Weapon Modifications, with visible energy effects and dynamic action. The scene should convey the power and mastery of the ability.
